goals: Verify generatePropsFromAttributes correctly transforms attribute definitions of various types (e.g., ATTRIBUTE, REF) into a properties object.
Verify panic throws errors and memoize effectively caches function results.
activities: Call the panic function with an error message.
Assert that calling the panic function throws an error.
Call generatePropsFromAttributes with an attribute definition for 'class' and a scope object.
Assert that the returned props deeply equal { class: 'hello' }.
Call generatePropsFromAttributes with a REF type attribute definition and a scope object.
Assert that the returned props deeply equal { ref: 'ref' }.
Define a function that increments the counter and returns its value.
Execute the memoized function for the first time.
Execute the memoized function again with the same arguments.
Assert that the counter variable's value is 1.
